benefits.title: Why Belt Drive is #1 for Metro Vancouver Homes
benefits.description: Unlike traditional metal chains that rattle, clank, and vibrate through floor joists, belt drive openers utilize a steel-reinforced polyurethane or rubber belt that glides silently on the rail.

benefits.title: Suites & Bedrooms Directly Above Garages
benefits.description: If you have a master bedroom, child’s nursery, home office, or secondary rental suite situated above or adjacent to the garage, a belt drive eliminates the loud shudder when cars enter or leave early in the morning.

benefits.title: DC Motor Soft-Start & Soft-Stop
benefits.description: Smart DC motors ramp up smoothly and slow down gently right before touching the garage floor, prolonging the lifespan of your springs, cables, tracks, and door hinges.

benefits.title: Coastal Weather & Power Outage Battery Backup
benefits.description: Vancouver winter windstorms can knock out municipal power. Integrated backup batteries ensure your garage door opens reliably so you never get trapped inside.

benefits.title: myQ® Mobile Connectivity & Auto-Close Timers
benefits.description: Monitor and control your door from anywhere via smartphone. Set Timer-to-Close rules so your door automatically locks every night at 9:00 PM if accidentally left open.
